vision.statement: An AI-powered transit assistant for Gainesville RTS riders that understands plain-language questions and guides the customer to the right answer — whether that's a real-time ETA or a scheduled departure time.
vision.cx_journey: Customer arrives at the assistant and types a question in plain language (e.g. 'When does the next 75 leave Butler Plaza?'). The assistant leads the interaction — asking clarifying questions when needed — until it can deliver the specific ETA or schedule information the rider needs.
vision.wizard_strategy: The Trip Wizard is the conversation flow prototype. It makes the decision tree explicit (intent → route → stop → direction → result) in a structured UI so the paths can be validated. Once proven, the same guided logic is translated into the chat assistant's prompting — the AI replicates the wizard's flow in natural language instead of button clicks.
vision.end_state: A single assistant interface where any RTS rider can ask a transit question in plain English (or Spanish) and get a reliable, accurate answer without needing to know stop IDs, route numbers, or schedules.

summary.goal: Deliver a stable Gainesville RTS backend with realtime bus info, schedule support, and a user-facing web assistant/dashboard.

tasks.title: Re-enable chat assistant at /chat
tasks.details: Replaced disabled placeholder in chat.html with real chat UI wired to chat_v2.js. Uses #chat-panel.standalone layout with 55vh message area, End Session button, language toggle, and full session/history management. /chat link restored to dashboard nav.

tasks.title: Add local LLM (Ollama) support for development testing
tasks.details: agent_service.py now reads OPENAI_BASE_URL env var via _openai_client() helper. Set it to http://localhost:11434/v1 to route all LLM calls to local Ollama (llama3.1:8b). .env.local.example and run_local.sh added for repeatable local dev workflow. Dashboard improved with vision panel, area grouping, and nav links.

tasks.title: Reliability and data persistence improvements
tasks.details: Analytics log migrated from ephemeral JSON-lines file to SQLite (survives Render redeploys). webqa.py now has go-rts.com as fallback and only locks the index when pages actually cached. Session timeout extended from 5 to 30 minutes. CORS reads from CORS_ORIGINS env var.

tasks.title: Split agent_service.py into focused modules
tasks.details: agent_service.py is ~1500 lines handling regex extraction, LLM intent parsing, cache, stop resolution, fallback chains, language detection, and button generation. Split into: intent_extractor.py, stop_resolver.py, response_builder.py, and a thin orchestrator.

tasks.title: Replace keyword overlap in webqa.py with OpenAI embeddings
tasks.details: Current token-overlap scoring misses synonyms and context. Replace with text-embedding-3-small vector similarity search. Data is small enough to embed entirely in memory on startup.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for parse_date, parse_time, and intent extraction
tasks.details: schedule_service.parse_date and parse_time handle many edge cases (weekdays, tomorrow, 12am/pm, etc.) with no test coverage. agent_service intent extraction is similarly untested. A small pytest suite would catch regressions.

tasks.title: Fix XSS: escape API answer before innerHTML in wizard.js
tasks.details: fetchSchedule places the raw LLM answer string directly into innerHTML. Add escapeHtml() and escape the answer before DOM insertion; apply styleExceptionNotes and fallback note after escaping.

tasks.title: Remove disabled chat panel from wizard.html
tasks.details: wizard.html has a grayed-out chat section below the working wizard. It signals 'broken' rather than 'coming soon'. Remove it; chat being in development phase is already communicated on /chat.

tasks.title: Show route names in wizard route selection buttons
tasks.details: renderStepRoute shows only route numbers. /api/routes already returns r.name (e.g. 'Rosa Parks to Butler Plaza TS'). Display it so riders know which route to pick.

tasks.title: Add route filter input to wizard route selection step
tasks.details: With 20+ routes as buttons, mobile users have to scroll through a wall of options. Add a search/filter input above the route grid to narrow down by number or name.

tasks.title: Fix index.html assistant button to point to /wizard instead of /chat
tasks.details: index.html:134 has 'Open RTS Assistant' linking to /chat, which is disabled. Points users to a dead-end. Change href to /wizard.

tasks.title: Fuzzy stop name resolution in agent (fix 'santa fe' type queries)
tasks.details: When a user says 'santa fe' or 'Walmart on 34th', the agent asks for a stop ID instead of resolving it. Need fuzzy matching against GTFS stop names (stop_name column) so natural landmark references resolve to stop_id. Approach: load stop names into memory at startup, score against user input using token overlap or embeddings, pass matched stop_id to existing ETA/schedule lookup.

tasks.title: Fix session fragmentation across Gunicorn workers
tasks.details: SessionManager is in-memory per worker. With multiple Gunicorn workers, request 1 on worker A and request 2 on worker B lose session context. Quickest fix: set workers=1 in render.yaml startCommand. Proper fix: SQLite-backed or Redis-backed session store shared across workers.

tasks.title: Add rate limiting to /api/agent to prevent API cost abuse
tasks.details: No rate limiting on /api/agent. Each request can fire up to 4 OpenAI calls. One user or bot can drain API quota. Add Flask-Limiter: 30 requests/hour per IP (configurable via env var). Return 429 with a clear message when limit hit.

tasks.title: Set CORS_ORIGINS env var in Render to restrict to production domain
tasks.details: CORS_ORIGINS code support added but env var not set in Render. Currently any website can call the API. Set CORS_ORIGINS=https://rts-backend-7ru5.onrender.com in Render environment variables dashboard.

tasks.title: Fix webqa.py hardcoded gpt-4o-mini (ignores OPENAI_MODEL env var)
tasks.details: webqa.py line 20 hardcodes model='gpt-4o-mini' instead of reading os.getenv('OPENAI_MODEL', 'gpt-4o-mini'). When OPENAI_BASE_URL points to Ollama locally, webqa still calls OpenAI directly. One-line fix.

tasks.title: Add retry with exponential backoff for OpenAI API calls
tasks.details: All 5 OpenAI client calls in agent_service.py silently fail on 429 or 500 with no retry. Add tenacity or manual backoff: 3 retries, 1s/2s/4s delays. Log retry attempts to analytics. This prevents transient OpenAI errors from reaching the user.

tasks.title: Reduce OpenAI calls from up to 4 down to 1-2 per agent request
tasks.details: Current flow can fire: intent extraction + history summary + humanization + direction clarification = 4 calls. Combine intent extraction and humanization into a single structured prompt. Skip humanization when the GTFS engine returns a deterministic answer. Skip history summary when history is short enough to fit in context.

tasks.title: Add input length and content validation to /api/agent
tasks.details: The 'message' field has no length limit. A 50k-character message would hit OpenAI token limits and possibly crash. Add: max 1000 characters, strip control characters, return 400 with clear error if invalid. Also validate session_id format.

tasks.title: Configure Gunicorn workers in render.yaml to avoid session loss
tasks.details: render.yaml startCommand should specify --workers 1 until sessions are moved to a shared store. Multiple workers with in-memory sessions cause users to lose conversation context mid-session. Also set --timeout 120 to handle slow LLM responses.

tasks.title: Improve GTFS stop name fuzzy matching for natural language stop references
tasks.details: Related to stop-name-resolution. Beyond simple token overlap, use Levenshtein distance or embeddings to match 'Rosa Parks' to 'Rosa Parks Transit Center', 'Publix on Archer' to stops near that landmark. Load stop name→id mapping at startup.

tasks.title: Handle OpenAI 429 rate limit errors gracefully
tasks.details: Currently if OpenAI returns 429 (rate limited), the agent silently returns a fallback with no user feedback and no retry. Detect RateLimitError specifically, wait 2s and retry once, then return a clear 'service busy, try again in a moment' message.

tasks.title: Automate GTFS schedule data refresh on RTS service changes
tasks.details: GTFS SQLite is built once at deploy time. RTS publishes new schedules each semester and for service changes. Stale data means wrong answers. Add: a /api/admin/rebuild-gtfs endpoint (token-protected) that re-fetches GTFS zip and rebuilds the DB, plus a cron trigger or Render deploy hook.

tasks.title: Use OpenAI structured outputs (JSON schema) for intent extraction
tasks.details: Intent extraction currently asks the LLM to return JSON in a system prompt and hopes it complies. Replace with OpenAI's response_format={type:'json_schema', schema:{...}} to guarantee field names, types, and presence. Eliminates regex fallback parsing and JSON parse errors.
